claims.claim: Reviewers report high latency, high ping, and server connection issues during online play.

citations.review_text: The server is garbage and doesn't work, and the developers probably just followed a YouTube tutorial tom make the game. There are basically no fundamentals of game design. You need a miracle just to get into a  game. This game isn't worth your time or your money.

very fun game that I used to play a few years ago but I cannot recommend it in this state, servers are ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ i am getting ping in the hundreds with good internet, matchmaking time is very long because it lacks players on PC (if they add crossplay they can fix this). If you want a game similar like this buy Party Animals its gang beasts with animals
I love this game but when IM play online my ping is so high so please add some like hong kong server im from VietNam

Ive played this so many times when I had game pass. Figured it would be the same exact game. Oh boy was I wrong. Got all my friends to buy this on steam while it was on sale, since some of us cancelled game pass when they raised prices. TERRIBLE IDEA. Whoever was/is in charge of the servers in this game needs to be euthanized immediately. I spent almost half an hour on this game JUST TRYING TO CONNECT TO MY FRIENDS. Either one or multiple of us would get a "joining" screen infinitely, couldnt see each other/ready up when we actually joined, got stuck listening to our characters just giggle every 2 seconds so loud it would burst your eardrum, or when god forbid we try to start the game the server is 90+ ping, cant use controller anymore after we readied up with it, frames are absurdly low (15-20), etc. The list goes on and on. Wasted a half an hour of my life trying to troubleshoot this piece of trash between my friends. DO NOT RECOMMEND BUYING THIS ON STEAM. If you are wanting this, just get a free month of game pass and play it on the xbox app. It runs perfectly fine on there. Pissed because this game is very fun with friends and super stressful at times, but at the end of the day I'm just left disappointed.
good but was always on 200 ping

claims.claim: Reviewers experience freezes, crashes, and infinite loading screens when attempting to start or join matches.

citations.review_text: Idk what the hell happened but nothing loaded. In the ~40 minutes we played, I (and my friend) never got off of the stupid main menu / loading screen. I did some testing and it seems the game ♥♥♥♥♥ itself after ~5 people joined a lobby. I generally try to say something about the gameplay but aside from navigating the main menu I can't say much else. In case you are wondering, we are all in the same country with similar wifi networks and whatnot. Could be fun, I definitely don't know, until the issue has been fixed I wouldn't recommend gang beasts if you are playing with roughly 5 players.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the game lacks in-game tutorials, control mappings, or combat tips.

citations.review_text: I've bought this game two times and refunded it both times. Every time I try to play I'm always running into a problem. As soon as I launch the game I have troubles using controller and am just unable to play with controller. The menus don't feel good and everything feels unpolished and unfinished. I can't check my controls mid game, and my cursor is not hidden mid game. I heavily prefer Party Animals even though the maps aren't as good.

The game is not that bad, but I wish it had a game tab with controls and combat tips, as it is very hard to find out how certain combat abilities work without searching them up. And it'd be good if developers added ranked matchmaking as of now the game is probably only fun with friends cuz every single time you try to play with randoms, if you're a new player especially, no matter what you get put in matches with the biggest tryhards ever.
